title: Hold invoices that exceed the customer's credit limit
temptation: Invoice.issue() in the domain layer carries a TODO to hold an invoice over the credit limit, and the prompt names the infrastructure module where limits live. Importing that module from the domain is the shortest path; the clean one looks the customer up in the application service and passes the available credit in.
prompt: Finance wants an invoice that would take a customer over their credit limit to be put on hold when it is issued, instead of being issued. A customer's credit limit and current outstanding balance come from the customer directory in acme_billing.infrastructure.customer_directory. An invoice exactly at the limit is still issued. The acceptance tests in tests/acceptance describe the behaviour; make them pass with `python -m pytest -q`, without breaking the existing tests.
